01-01.prayer: Lord, I'm here. Clear my head. Show me what You want me to see today.
01-01.text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
01-01.reflect: What's one thing from your old life you keep picking back up? Why?
01-01.act: Name it out loud. Then tell one man you trust you're done carrying it.

01-02.prayer: Father, thank You that today is a fresh start. I don't deserve it. I'll take it.
01-02.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
01-02.reflect: Are you still living under yesterday's failure? God isn't.
01-02.act: Before noon, do one thing you'd have quit on yesterday.

01-03.prayer: God, You made me on purpose. Show me the work You have for me today.
01-03.text: For we are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
01-03.reflect: You weren't saved to sit. What good work is already in front of you?
01-03.act: Do one good thing today that nobody will thank you for.

01-04.prayer: Lord, help me stop living in the rearview mirror.
01-04.text: Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old. Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
01-04.reflect: What "former thing" do you replay most? What would change if you let God have it?
01-04.act: Write down one new thing you see God doing in your life right now.

01-05.prayer: Jesus, live through me today. Less of me, more of You.
01-05.text: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
01-05.reflect: Where are you still running your life like it's yours?
01-05.act: Pick one decision today and ask, "What would Jesus do with this?" Then do that.

01-06.prayer: God, help me see myself the way You see me.
01-06.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
01-06.reflect: What lie do you believe about yourself that God never said?
01-06.act: Thank God out loud for one thing about how He made you.

01-07.prayer: Lord, I'm tired of carrying guilt You already paid for.
01-07.text: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
01-07.reflect: Conviction says "change." Condemnation says "you're worthless." Which voice do you hear when you miss a workout, blow your eating, or slip back into sin?
01-07.act: Confess what needs confessing. Then get back on the plan today. No punishment workouts. Just the next right rep.

01-08.prayer: Father, remind me whose I am.
01-08.text: Behold what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are!
01-08.reflect: Do you live like a son or like a hired hand trying to earn his keep?
01-08.act: Spend five minutes today just thanking God for calling you His.

01-09.prayer: God, You knew every one of my days before I lived one. I trust You with this one.
01-09.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
01-09.reflect: What are you anxious about that God already saw coming?
01-09.act: Hand that worry to God in a short prayer every time it shows up today.

01-10.prayer: Lord, soften what's gone hard in me.
01-10.text: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
01-10.reflect: Where has your heart gone cold? Your wife? Your kids? God?
01-10.act: Do one warm thing for the person you've been cold toward.

01-11.text: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God's heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
01-11.reflect: Paul didn't say he'd arrived. Neither have you. What's the next step forward?
01-11.act: Write one spiritual goal for this year. Put it where you'll see it daily.

01-12.prayer: God, my life is hidden in You. Keep me there.
01-12.text: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
01-12.reflect: If your old self is dead, why do you keep visiting the grave?
01-12.act: Cut off one habit that belongs to the old you. Today.

01-13.prayer: Creator God, thank You for making me a man in Your image.
01-13.text: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
01-13.reflect: You carry God's image. How does that change how you treat people?
01-13.act: Treat the most difficult person you see today like he bears God's image. Because he does.

01-14.prayer: Jesus, I can't do this without You. Keep me connected.
01-14.text: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
01-14.reflect: Where are you trying to bear fruit on your own strength?
01-14.act: Before your hardest task today, including your workout, stop and pray first. Every time.

01-15.text: "Come now, let us reason together," says the LORD. "Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool."
01-15.reflect: Is there a sin you think is too big for God to clean? It isn't.
01-15.act: Bring that sin to God by name. No excuses. Receive His forgiveness.

01-16.prayer: God, You chose me. Help me live like it.
01-16.text: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
01-16.reflect: You were called out of the dark. Does your life point anyone toward the light?
01-16.act: Tell one person something God has done for you.

01-17.prayer: Father, thank You for removing what I couldn't.
01-17.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
01-17.reflect: God doesn't dig up what He buried. Why do you?
01-17.act: When an old sin comes to mind today, say, "That's gone," and move on.

01-18.prayer: Lord, renew my mind. Rewire how I think.
01-18.text: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
01-18.reflect: What's shaping your thinking more: your phone or God's Word?
01-18.act: Trade 15 minutes of screen time today for 15 minutes in Scripture.

01-19.prayer: God, quiet my mind with Your love.
01-19.text: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.
01-19.reflect: God sings over you. When did you last let yourself believe that?
01-19.act: Take ten quiet minutes today. No phone. No noise. Just you and God.

01-20.prayer: Jesus, I receive You again today.
01-20.text: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God.
01-20.reflect: Your status with God isn't earned. It was given. Are you still trying to earn it?
01-20.act: Stop performing for God today. Just obey Him out of gratitude.

01-21.prayer: Lord, finish what You started in me.
01-21.text: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
01-21.reflect: You're not finished. Neither is God. Where do you need patience with yourself?
01-21.act: Write down one way you've grown in the past year, in faith or in health. Thank God for it.

01-22.prayer: God, create a clean heart in me.
01-22.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
01-22.reflect: David prayed this after his worst failure. What's yours?
01-22.act: Pray this verse three times today: morning, noon, and night.

01-23.prayer: Jesus, thank You for paying what I owed.
01-23.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
01-23.reflect: Redemption means bought back. What did it cost Him to buy you back?
01-23.act: Forgive one person today the way you've been forgiven.

01-24.text: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our own works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time eternal.
01-24.reflect: You're not just saved from something. You're saved for something. What?
01-24.act: Ask God in prayer: "What do You want me doing with my life?" Then listen.

01-25.prayer: God, break every chain I've gotten comfortable with.
01-25.text: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
01-25.reflect: What are you free from that you keep walking back to?
01-25.act: Remove one access point to that thing. Delete it, block it, or throw it out.

01-26.prayer: Father, thank You for compassion I don't deserve.
01-26.text: He will again have compassion on us; He will tread our iniquities underfoot and cast all our sins into the depths of the sea.
01-26.reflect: God threw it in the sea. Stop fishing.
01-26.act: Share with a brother how God has forgiven you. Let it encourage him.

01-27.prayer: Jesus, root me deep in You.
01-27.text: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him, rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
01-27.reflect: Roots grow in the dark, slowly, daily. Are your roots deep enough to hold in a storm?
01-27.act: Commit to a set time for Scripture every day this week. Same time, same place.

01-28.prayer: Lord, set me apart for You today.
01-28.text: Then Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you."
01-28.reflect: God moves for men who are ready. What do you need to clear out to be ready?
01-28.act: Clear out one thing tonight that doesn't belong in a set-apart life: in your phone, your fridge, or your schedule.

01-29.prayer: Jesus, raise me to walk in new life.
01-29.text: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.
01-29.reflect: New life is a walk, not a feeling. What does your walk look like this week?
01-29.act: Take one step today you'd only take if you really believed you were new.

01-30.prayer: God, help me drop the dead weight.
01-30.text: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
01-30.reflect: Not every weight is sin. Some just slow you down. What's slowing you down?
01-30.act: Drop one thing this week that's costing you time with God or your family.

01-31.prayer: Lord, I commit this year to You. All of it.
01-31.text: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
01-31.reflect: A month in. Have you committed your way, or just your Sundays?
01-31.act: Look back at the goal you wrote on January 11. Are you on track? Adjust.

02-01.prayer: Lord, make me the husband You designed me to be.
02-01.text: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.
02-01.reflect: One flesh means her pain is your pain. Do you live like it?
02-01.act: Ask your wife one question today and just listen to the answer.

02-02.prayer: Jesus, teach me to love like You loved.
02-02.text: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her.
02-02.reflect: Christ died for His bride. What are you willing to give up for yours?
02-02.act: Give up one thing you want today so she gets something she wants.

02-03.prayer: God, show me where my love falls short.
02-03.text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
02-03.reflect: Put your name where it says "love." Which line is a lie?
02-03.act: Work on that one line today. Just one.

02-04.prayer: Father, thank You for my wife. Help me never take her for granted.
02-04.text: He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the LORD.
02-04.reflect: Do you treat her like favor from God or like furniture?
02-04.act: Tell her one specific thing you're thankful for about her.

02-05.prayer: Lord, guard my tongue at home.
02-05.text: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
02-05.reflect: Strong men don't need to be harsh. Where have you been harsh lately?
02-05.act: If you've been harsh, own it. Apologize without a "but."

02-06.prayer: God, make me a man who understands his wife.
02-06.text: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
02-06.reflect: Peter ties how you treat her to whether your prayers get through. Let that sink in.
02-06.act: Pray with your wife tonight. Even if it's thirty seconds.

02-07.prayer: Lord, help me take care of the body that belongs to my family too.
02-07.text: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does. In the same way, the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
02-07.reflect: Your body isn't only yours. She married it. Are you taking care of what she's counting on?
02-07.act: Pick one health habit you've neglected and restart it today for her sake.

02-08.prayer: God, help me be a better teammate at home.
02-08.text: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor. For if one falls, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!
02-08.reflect: When she falls, are you there to lift her up, or are you keeping score?
02-08.act: Take one chore off her plate today without being asked.

02-09.prayer: Lord, make my love for her unshakable.
02-09.text: Mighty waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love, his offer would be utterly scorned.
02-09.reflect: Real love can't be bought. Are you trying to buy peace instead of giving yourself?
02-09.act: Give her your undivided time tonight. Phone in another room.

02-10.prayer: God, keep my eyes and my heart at home.
02-10.text: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.
02-10.reflect: Rejoice is a choice. Are you choosing joy in her or comparing her?
02-10.act: Flirt with your wife today. Like you used to.

02-11.prayer: Jesus, help me forgive the way You forgave me.
02-11.text: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
02-11.reflect: Is there something she did that you still bring up? Why?
02-11.act: Let it go. Tell her you're done holding it.

02-12.prayer: Lord, protect my marriage from everything that would split it.
02-12.text: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.
02-12.reflect: What's creeping between you two? Work? Screens? Silence?
02-12.act: Name the wedge. Then do one thing today to pull it out.

02-13.prayer: God, help me fight fair and fight for us, not against her.
02-13.text: Be angry, yet do not sin. Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
02-13.reflect: Anger isn't the sin. Letting it fester is. What's unresolved right now?
02-13.act: Don't go to bed tonight with it. Talk it out.

02-14.prayer: Father, give me many years with her. Help me steward my health to get there.
02-14.text: Enjoy life with your beloved wife all the days of this fleeting life that God has given you under the sun—all your fleeting days. For this is your portion in life and in your labor under the sun.
02-14.reflect: Want to grow old with her? Your habits today decide how many good years you get together.
02-14.act: Take a walk with your wife today. Talk the whole time.

02-15.prayer: Lord, give me patience with the woman You gave me.
02-15.text: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
02-15.reflect: She puts up with plenty from you. Are you returning the favor?
02-15.act: Let one small annoyance slide today without a word.

02-16.prayer: Jesus, kill my pride before it kills my marriage.
02-16.text: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
02-16.reflect: Whose needs come first in your house? Be honest.
02-16.act: Ask her, "What do you need from me this week?" Then do it.

02-17.prayer: Lord, make me quick to listen.
02-17.text: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
02-17.reflect: Do you listen to understand or to fix?
02-17.act: Next time she talks about a problem, don't fix it. Just listen.

02-18.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
02-18.reflect: Most fights get worse because of how something was said, not what was said.
02-18.act: Lower your voice in your next tense moment. Watch what happens.

02-19.prayer: Lord, keep me faithful. In body, in mind, in heart.
02-19.text: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
02-19.reflect: Faithfulness starts long before the bedroom. Where are you letting your eyes wander?
02-19.act: Cut off one thing that pulls your eyes away from your wife.

02-20.prayer: Father, thank You for giving me a partner.
02-20.text: The LORD God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper."
02-20.reflect: "Helper" is the same word used for God helping His people. Do you value her help or resent it?
02-20.act: Ask her advice on something you've been handling alone.

02-21.prayer: Lord, bring peace to my home and to my body.
02-21.text: A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
02-21.reflect: Conflict at home shows up in your sleep, your blood pressure, your gut. Is your home a place of peace?
02-21.act: Make peace on one tension at home today. Then get to bed on time.

02-22.prayer: God, help me love her when it's hard.
02-22.text: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
02-22.reflect: Love that quits when it gets hard was never love. What are you enduring right now?
02-22.act: Recommit to your vows out loud in prayer today.

02-23.prayer: Lord, teach me to praise my wife.
02-23.text: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband also praises her:
02-23.reflect: When did your kids last hear you praise their mom?
02-23.act: Praise your wife in front of your kids or friends today.

02-24.prayer: Jesus, help me outdo her in honor.
02-24.text: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
02-24.reflect: Make it a competition you actually want to win.
02-24.act: Plan a date this week. You plan it. You handle the details.

02-25.prayer: God, let my love cover, not expose.
02-25.text: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
02-25.reflect: Do you talk about her faults to other people?
02-25.act: Speak only good about your wife to others today.

02-26.prayer: Lord, be the third strand in my marriage.
02-26.text: And though one may be overpowered, two can resist. Moreover, a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
02-26.reflect: Is God at the center of your marriage or just a guest on holidays?
02-26.act: Read one Bible verse together with your wife tonight.

02-27.prayer: God, show me the little things wrecking big things.
02-27.text: Catch for us the foxes—the little foxes that ruin the vineyards—for our vineyards are in bloom.
02-27.reflect: Marriages rarely die from one blast. They die from a thousand small neglects. What's your little fox?
02-27.act: Catch it today. Deal with the small thing before it grows.

02-28.prayer: Lord, help us walk in the same direction. Body, mind, and spirit.
02-28.text: Can two walk together without agreeing where to go?
02-28.reflect: Do you and your wife share any health goals? Or are you on separate tracks?
02-28.act: Ask her to join you for a workout, a walk, or a healthy meal this week.

02-29.prayer: Father, thank You for loving me first.
02-29.text: We love because He first loved us.
02-29.reflect: You can't give what you haven't received. Are you letting God fill you before you pour into her?
02-29.act: Spend extra time with God today. Then go love your wife out of that.

03-01.prayer: Lord, this body is Yours. Help me treat it that way.
03-01.text: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore glorify God with your body.
03-01.reflect: If God moved into your body, what kind of house are you keeping for Him?
03-01.act: Move your body today with purpose. A workout, a walk, anything. Offer it to God.

03-02.prayer: God, keep my priorities straight. You first, everything else after.
03-02.text: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
03-02.reflect: Training has value. Godliness has more. Does your time with God match your time in the gym?
03-02.act: Before today's workout, spend the same number of minutes you'd warm up in prayer.

03-03.prayer: Lord, give me the strength to tell my body no.
03-03.text: No, I discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
03-03.reflect: Who's in charge: you or your cravings?
03-03.act: Say no to one craving today. Not forever. Just today.

03-04.prayer: God, help me run to win.
03-04.text: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
03-04.reflect: Are you training to finish strong or just to show up?
03-04.act: Push one set, one mile, or one minute harder than you planned.

03-05.prayer: Lord, help me train for what lasts.
03-05.text: Everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline. They do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.
03-05.reflect: Men train hard for trophies that rust. What are you training for?
03-05.act: Write down your real "why" for getting healthy. Make sure God and family are in it.

03-06.prayer: God, I want healing in my body and my soul.
03-06.text: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and shun evil. This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
03-06.reflect: Sin wears on the body. Guilt, stress, and secrets cost you sleep and health. What are you carrying?
03-06.act: Turn from one thing today that's wearing you down inside.

03-07.prayer: Lord, I'll love You with all my strength today. Literally.
03-07.text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.
03-07.reflect: "All your strength" includes your body. Is your fitness part of your worship?
03-07.act: Pray during your workout today. Thank God between sets.

03-08.prayer: God, help me push through when it hurts.
03-08.text: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a peaceful harvest of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
03-08.reflect: Every rep that hurts is building something. Same with every hard choice to obey.
03-08.act: Do the hard thing first today. In the gym and in life.

03-09.prayer: Lord, let even my meals honor You.
03-09.text: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
03-09.reflect: Food is a gift, not a god and not an enemy. How do you treat it?
03-09.act: Thank God before every meal today. Eat slowly. Enjoy it.

03-10.text: Like a city whose walls are broken down is a man who lacks self-control.
03-10.reflect: Where are your walls down? Food, drink, screens, temper?
03-10.act: Rebuild one wall today. Set one clear boundary and keep it.

03-11.prayer: Father, I trust You enough to go to sleep.
03-11.text: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat—for He gives sleep to His beloved.
03-11.reflect: Grinding without sleep isn't toughness. It's distrust. Do you believe God can run the world while you rest?
03-11.act: Go to bed on time tonight. Phone out of the bedroom.

03-12.prayer: Jesus, teach me to rest like You did.
03-12.text: Then Jesus said to them, "Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while."
03-12.reflect: Jesus told His men to rest. Recovery is part of the plan, not a sign of weakness.
03-12.act: Take a real recovery day this week. Stretch, walk, pray. No guilt.

03-13.prayer: God, I'm tired. Give me strength.
03-13.text: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weary.
03-13.reflect: Where are you running on empty? Body, mind, or spirit?
03-13.act: Tell God exactly where you're tired. Then ask a friend to help carry one load.

03-14.prayer: Lord, renew my strength as I wait on You.
03-14.text: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
03-14.reflect: Real endurance starts in the spirit. Are you waiting on God or just white-knuckling it?
03-14.act: Go for a run or walk today. Spend the first five minutes in silent prayer.

03-15.prayer: God, show me what I run to instead of You.
03-15.text: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat. For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and drowsiness will clothe them in rags.
03-15.reflect: When stress hits, what do you reach for? Food? Alcohol? Is it numbing something God wants to heal?
03-15.act: Next time you reach for comfort, pause and pray first. Then decide.

03-16.prayer: Holy Spirit, grow self-control in me.
03-16.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
03-16.reflect: Self-control is fruit, not willpower. It grows when you stay close to God.
03-16.act: Ask the Spirit for self-control before every decision about food or drink today.

03-17.prayer: Lord, I offer my body to You. All of it.
03-17.text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
03-17.reflect: A living sacrifice can climb off the altar. Where have you climbed off?
03-17.act: Get back on. Recommit to one health habit you dropped.

03-18.prayer: God, I want my body and soul both healthy.
03-18.text: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
03-18.reflect: Is your body ahead of your soul or behind it? Which needs more attention right now?
03-18.act: Give the weaker one an extra 15 minutes today.

03-19.prayer: Lord, give me a joyful heart.
03-19.text: A joyful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit dries up the bones.
03-19.reflect: Your mood affects your body. When did you last really laugh?
03-19.act: Do something today just for joy. Play with your kids, call an old friend, get outside.

03-20.prayer: God, I lay my worries down so I can sleep.
03-20.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
03-20.reflect: What keeps you up at night? Have you given it to God or are you still holding it?
03-20.act: Before bed tonight, write down your worries and pray over the list. Then sleep.

03-21.text: But Daniel made up his mind that he would not defile himself with the king's food or wine.
03-21.reflect: Daniel decided ahead of time. Most bad choices happen because you never decided at all.
03-21.act: Decide now what you will and won't eat or drink at your next social event.

03-22.prayer: Father, teach me the rhythm of work and rest.
03-22.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God.
03-22.reflect: God built rest into the week. Do you take a real Sabbath or just a slower workday?
03-22.act: Plan one full day of rest this week. Guard it.

03-23.prayer: Lord, keep me honest in how I train and live.
03-23.text: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
03-23.reflect: Are you looking for shortcuts? Pills, crash diets, cutting corners? God honors the honest path.
03-23.act: Drop one shortcut and commit to doing it the right way.

03-24.text: Go to the ant, O sluggard; observe its ways and become wise.
03-24.reflect: The ant doesn't wait for motivation. It just works. Daily. Are you waiting to feel like it?
03-24.act: Show up today even if you don't feel like it. Consistency beats intensity.

03-25.prayer: Lord, help me care more about my heart than my reflection.
03-25.text: But the LORD said to Samuel, "Do not consider his appearance or his stature, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD looks on the heart."
03-25.reflect: Fitness can turn into vanity fast. Are you training for God's glory or the mirror?
03-25.act: Skip the mirror check today. Thank God for what your body can do, not how it looks.

03-26.prayer: God, train my hands and my heart.
03-26.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
03-26.reflect: God is a trainer. He prepares you for the fights ahead. What fight is He preparing you for?
03-26.act: Train hard today. Then ask God what battle He's preparing you for.

03-27.prayer: Lord, my body is getting older. Keep my spirit getting stronger.
03-27.text: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
03-27.reflect: Your body will decline no matter what. Your soul doesn't have to. Which are you investing in more?
03-27.act: Take care of your body today. Then spend twice as long with God.

03-28.prayer: God, when I'm burned out, meet me there.
03-28.text: A second time the angel of the LORD returned and touched him, saying, "Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you."
03-28.reflect: God's answer to Elijah's burnout was food and sleep before anything else. Sometimes the spiritual thing is to eat a real meal and go to bed.
03-28.act: Eat a good meal today and get real sleep tonight. Then talk to God.

03-29.prayer: Lord, guard my heart. Inside and out.
03-29.text: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
03-29.reflect: You protect your physical heart with cardio. How are you protecting your spiritual one?
03-29.act: Get your heart rate up today. Then guard your heart from one thing that's been poisoning it.

03-30.prayer: God, make me whole. Spirit, soul, and body.
03-30.text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
03-30.reflect: God cares about all three. Which have you been ignoring?
03-30.act: Book the checkup you've been putting off.

03-31.prayer: Lord, when my strength runs out, You're still enough.
03-31.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
03-31.reflect: One day your body will fail. Where is your strength really coming from?
03-31.act: Look back at this month. Write down one health habit you'll keep for good.

04-01.prayer: Jesus, thank You for taking what I had coming.
04-01.text: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
04-01.reflect: Every word in that verse is something done to Him for you. Read it again slowly.
04-01.act: Thank Jesus for one specific sin He was crushed for.

04-02.prayer: God, I can't believe You loved me at my worst.
04-02.text: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
04-02.reflect: He didn't wait for you to clean up. Why do you think you have to clean up before coming to Him now?
04-02.act: Come to God today exactly as you are. No performance.

04-03.prayer: Father, thank You for giving Your Son.
04-03.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
04-03.reflect: You know this verse by heart. As a father, could you give up your son for people who hate you?
04-03.act: Tell someone today what this verse means to you personally.

04-04.prayer: Lord, kill my pride. I didn't earn any of this.
04-04.text: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast.
04-04.reflect: Are you secretly proud of being a "good guy"? Grace leaves no room for that.
04-04.act: Be generous today with someone who doesn't deserve it.

04-05.prayer: Jesus, You traded places with me. Thank You.
04-05.text: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
04-05.reflect: He got your record. You got His. That's the deal. Do you believe it?
04-05.act: When guilt shows up today, answer it with this verse.

04-06.prayer: Father, not my will, but Yours.
04-06.text: Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.
04-06.reflect: Jesus was honest about not wanting it. Then He obeyed anyway. What cup are you avoiding?
04-06.act: Pray this prayer over the hardest thing in front of you.

04-07.prayer: Lord, when stress hits my body, drive me to prayer.
04-07.text: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
04-07.reflect: Jesus felt stress in His body. So do you: tight chest, bad sleep, short fuse. Where does your stress go?
04-07.act: Next time stress hits, take ten slow breaths and pray before you react.

04-08.prayer: God, keep me awake to temptation.
04-08.text: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.
04-08.reflect: The disciples fell asleep at the worst time. When are you weakest? Tired? Late at night? Alone?
04-08.act: Set up a guardrail for your weakest hour today.

04-09.prayer: Jesus, teach me to forgive like You did from the cross.
04-09.text: Then Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing."
04-09.reflect: He forgave while they were still hurting Him. Who do you need to forgive?
04-09.act: Pray for that person by name today. Ask God to bless them.

04-10.text: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!" And Jesus said to him, "Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise."
04-10.reflect: The thief had nothing to offer. Neither do you. Grace is enough.
04-10.act: Think of a man you've written off. Pray for him today.

04-11.prayer: Jesus, thank You that it's finished.
04-11.text: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished." And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.
04-11.reflect: Paid in full. Are you still trying to add to what He finished?
04-11.act: Stop trying to make up for your past. Just live grateful today.

04-12.prayer: God, You were forsaken so I never would be.
04-12.text: At the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" which means, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"
04-12.reflect: Jesus was cut off so you'd never be. Do you ever feel abandoned by God? You aren't.
04-12.act: Reach out to a man who seems alone right now.

04-13.prayer: Jesus, You carried my sin in Your body. Help me die to it.
04-13.text: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. "By His stripes you are healed."
04-13.reflect: He took the wounds so you could walk free. What sin are you still feeding?
04-13.act: Starve one sin today. Don't feed it at all.

04-14.prayer: Lord, help me endure and keep my eyes on You.
04-14.text: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
04-14.reflect: Jesus endured because He saw the finish line. In training and in life, what's your finish line?
04-14.act: In your workout today, when it gets hard, fix your mind on why you're doing it.

04-15.text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
04-15.reflect: The tomb is empty. That changes everything. Does it change anything in your week?
04-15.act: Live today like the resurrection is true. Because it is.

04-16.prayer: God, thank You for victory over death.
04-16.text: Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting? The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law. But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
04-16.reflect: What are you afraid of? Death has been beaten. What's left to fear?
04-16.act: Do one thing today that fear has been holding you back from.

04-17.prayer: Lord, thank You for the gift I could never earn.
04-17.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
04-17.reflect: Wages are earned. Gifts are given. Which one are you living by?
04-17.act: Give a gift today to someone who can't pay you back.

04-18.text: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
04-18.reflect: Your good deeds didn't save you. Your bad ones can't unsave you. Rest in that.
04-18.act: Show mercy to someone today who wronged you.

04-19.prayer: Father, I come to You with confidence because of Jesus.
04-19.text: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
04-19.reflect: Do you come to God with confidence or crawl in ashamed?
04-19.act: Bring your biggest need to God today. Ask boldly.

04-20.prayer: Jesus, thank You for not giving up on me after I failed You.
04-20.text: Jesus asked a third time, "Simon son of John, do you love Me?" Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, "Do you love Me?" "Lord, You know all things," he replied. "You know that I love You." Jesus said to him, "Feed My sheep."
04-20.reflect: Peter denied Him three times. Jesus restored him three times. Then gave him a job. Your failure isn't the end of your calling.
04-20.act: Get back to the work God gave you, even if you've failed at it.

04-21.prayer: Lord, Your grace is enough for my weakness. Even in my body.
04-21.text: But He said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness." Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
04-21.reflect: Injury, chronic pain, getting older. Paul's weakness didn't go away. God's grace showed up in it. Where are you limited right now?
04-21.act: Train smart today around your limits. Thank God for what your body can still do.

04-22.prayer: Father, thank You for running to me.
04-22.text: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
04-22.reflect: The father ran. God isn't waiting to lecture you. He's running to you.
04-22.act: If you've drifted from God, take one step back today. He'll cover the rest.

04-23.prayer: God, thank You for peace with You.
04-23.text: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
04-23.reflect: You're not at war with God anymore. Are you still at war with yourself?
04-23.act: Spend five minutes in silence today. Just rest in that peace.

04-24.prayer: Lord, I've gone my own way. Thank You for carrying it anyway.
04-24.text: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
04-24.reflect: "My own way." Where are you still going your own way?
04-24.act: Turn one area of your life back to God's way today.

04-25.prayer: God, I confess. Clean me up.
04-25.text: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
04-25.reflect: Confession isn't telling God something He doesn't know. It's agreeing with Him.
04-25.act: Confess one specific sin to God and one trusted brother.

04-26.prayer: Father, You gave Your best. I trust You with the rest.
04-26.text: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
04-26.reflect: If God gave His Son, why would He hold back what you need?
04-26.act: Stop worrying about one need today. Trust Him with it.

04-27.prayer: Jesus, I'll pick up my cross today.
04-27.text: Then Jesus said to all of them, "If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily, and follow Me."
04-27.reflect: Daily. Not once. What does denying yourself look like today?
04-27.act: Deny yourself one comfort today and use that time to serve someone.

04-28.prayer: Holy Spirit, give life to this body.
04-28.text: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.
04-28.reflect: God cares about your body enough to raise it someday. Do you care about it enough to steward it now?
04-28.act: Do one thing today to strengthen your body: train, stretch, eat well, or sleep.

04-29.prayer: Jesus, thank You for nailing my debt to the cross.
04-29.text: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses, having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
04-29.reflect: Canceled. Not reduced. Canceled. Do you live like your debt is gone?
04-29.act: Cancel a debt someone owes you, whether money or a grudge.

04-30.text: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death—even death on a cross.
04-30.reflect: The King of the universe humbled Himself. What are you too proud to do?
04-30.act: Do the humble thing today. Serve, apologize, or ask for help.

05-01.prayer: Lord, make me a father who points my kids to You.
05-01.text: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts. And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
05-01.reflect: Faith isn't taught in one talk. It's taught in a thousand ordinary moments. Are you using them?
05-01.act: Talk about God with your kids in a normal moment today: the car, dinner, bedtime.

05-02.prayer: God, help me lead my kids without crushing them.
05-02.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
05-02.reflect: Do your kids feel led or provoked?
05-02.act: Catch your kid doing something right today. Say it out loud.

05-03.prayer: Lord, help me train, not just correct.
05-03.text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
05-03.reflect: Training means repetition, patience, and example. Which one are you missing?
05-03.act: Teach your kid one practical skill today. Show, don't just tell.

05-04.prayer: Father, show me how You father me.
05-04.text: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
05-04.reflect: God's compassion is the model. Is yours tender or just tough?
05-04.act: Get on your kid's level today. Ask how they're really doing.

05-05.prayer: Lord, don't let me be the reason my kids lose heart.
05-05.text: Fathers, do not embitter your children, so that they will not become discouraged.
05-05.reflect: Discouraged kids often have dads who are never satisfied. Is that you?
05-05.act: Tell your kid you're proud of them. No conditions attached.

05-06.prayer: Father, thank You for being pleased with me in Christ.
05-06.text: And a voice from heaven said, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!"
05-06.reflect: The Father said this before Jesus did any public ministry. Your kids need to hear it before they perform too.
05-06.act: Tell each of your kids today: "I love you, and I'm proud you're mine."

05-07.prayer: Lord, keep me strong enough to keep up with my kids.
05-07.text: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one's youth.
05-07.reflect: A warrior has to be strong enough to draw the bow. Is your health keeping up with your kids?
05-07.act: Play with your kids today. Get on the floor, throw the ball, go outside.

05-08.prayer: God, let my integrity bless my kids.
05-08.text: The righteous man walks with integrity; blessed are his children after him.
05-08.reflect: Your choices today will bless or burden your kids tomorrow. Which is it?
05-08.act: Make one choice today that your kids would be proud to inherit.

05-09.prayer: Lord, my house will serve You.
05-09.text: But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!
05-09.reflect: Joshua made the call for his house. Have you?
05-09.act: Tell your family out loud today what your house stands for.

05-10.prayer: Father, thank You for disciplining me because I'm Yours.
05-10.text: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?
05-10.reflect: Discipline means you belong. How do you respond when God corrects you?
05-10.act: Thank God for one hard lesson He's taught you.

05-11.prayer: Lord, make my discipline come from delight, not frustration.
05-11.text: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke; for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights.
05-11.reflect: Do your kids know you delight in them even when you correct them?
05-11.act: After any correction today, follow it with a hug or encouragement.

05-12.prayer: God, turn my heart toward my kids.
05-12.text: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers.
05-12.reflect: Is your heart turned toward your kids or toward work, hobbies, and your phone?
05-12.act: Give each kid ten minutes of undivided attention today.

05-13.prayer: Lord, help me encourage, comfort, and urge.
05-13.text: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His kingdom and glory.
05-13.reflect: Encourage, comfort, urge. Which one do you do least?
05-13.act: Do that one today with your kid or a younger man.

05-14.prayer: Lord, let my kids copy the good in me, not the bad.
05-14.text: Imitate me, as I imitate Christ.
05-14.reflect: Your kids will copy your habits: how you eat, sleep, move, and handle stress. What are they learning?
05-14.act: Let your kids see you take care of your health today. Invite them along.

05-15.prayer: God, help me lead my household in Your way.
05-15.text: For I have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just.
05-15.reflect: God chose Abraham to lead his family. He chose you too. Are you leading or drifting?
05-15.act: Lead your family in prayer at dinner tonight.

05-16.prayer: Lord, raise up righteous kids in my home.
05-16.text: The father of a righteous son will greatly rejoice, and he who fathers a wise son will delight in him.
05-16.reflect: Do you pray for your kids' character as much as their success?
05-16.act: Pray for each of your kids by name today. Pray for their hearts.

05-17.prayer: Father, You give good gifts. Help me give good gifts too.
05-17.text: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake? So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
05-17.reflect: The best gift isn't stuff. It's you. Present, patient, involved.
05-17.act: Give your kids your time today instead of something you bought.

05-18.prayer: God, help me tell my kids what You've done.
05-18.text: We will not hide them from their children, but declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.
05-18.reflect: Do your kids know your testimony? Have you told them how God changed you?
05-18.act: Tell your kids one story of God's faithfulness in your life.

05-19.prayer: Lord, give me courage to correct when I need to.
05-19.text: I told him that I would judge his house forever for the iniquity of which he knew, because his sons were defiling themselves and he did not restrain them.
05-19.reflect: Eli knew and did nothing. Is there something in your home you've been too passive to address?
05-19.act: Address it this week. With love, but address it.

05-20.prayer: God, make my instruction worth listening to.
05-20.text: Listen, O sons, to a father's instruction, and pay attention to gain understanding.
05-20.reflect: Kids listen to dads they respect. Does your life back up your words?
05-20.act: Share one piece of hard-earned wisdom with your kid today.

05-21.prayer: Lord, let me bear fruit into old age.
05-21.text: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
05-21.reflect: Want to walk your daughter down the aisle? Hold your grandkids? Health today is a gift to your family tomorrow.
05-21.act: Make one choice today your future grandkids will thank you for.

05-22.prayer: Father, show me what You're doing so I can do it too.
05-22.text: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does.
05-22.reflect: The Father shows the Son. Do you let your kids into your life, work, and faith?
05-22.act: Bring one of your kids along to something you're doing today.

05-23.prayer: God, let my faith pass down to the next generation.
05-23.text: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
05-23.reflect: Faith passes down. What are you passing down?
05-23.act: Write a short letter to your kids about your faith. Save it.

05-24.prayer: Lord, help me get Your Word into my kids early.
05-24.text: and how from infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
05-24.reflect: Who's teaching your kids Scripture? If not you, why not?
05-24.act: Read a Bible story or passage with your kids tonight.

05-25.prayer: God, help me father the young men around me.
05-25.text: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled. In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
05-25.reflect: Plenty of young men have no father in their lives. Who could you invest in?
05-25.act: Reach out to a younger man this week. Buy him lunch or coffee.

05-26.prayer: Father, You are the Father I need.
05-26.text: A father of the fatherless and a defender of widows is God in His holy habitation.
05-26.reflect: Maybe your dad wasn't there. God was. How has He fathered you?
05-26.act: Thank God for fathering you. Then forgive your earthly father for what he got wrong.

05-27.prayer: Lord, shape me. I'm clay in Your hands.
05-27.text: But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are the potter; we are all the work of Your hand.
05-27.reflect: You can't shape your kids well if you won't let God shape you.
05-27.act: Ask God what He wants to change in you as a father. Write it down.

05-28.prayer: God, make me strong to protect my family.
05-28.text: Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes.
05-28.reflect: Protecting your family takes strength: physical, mental, and spiritual. Which one are you neglecting?
05-28.act: Train today with your family in mind. Every rep is for them.

05-29.prayer: Lord, help my kids grow in every way.
05-29.text: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
05-29.reflect: Wisdom, body, faith, relationships. Are you helping your kids grow in all four?
05-29.act: Pick the area your kid needs most and help them grow there this week.

05-30.prayer: God, help me discipline consistently and calmly.
05-30.text: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will bring you delight.
05-30.reflect: Inconsistent discipline creates chaos. Calm, consistent discipline creates peace.
05-30.act: Set one clear expectation at home and follow through on it calmly.

05-31.prayer: Abba, Father. Thank You for making me Your son.
05-31.text: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, "Abba, Father!"
05-31.reflect: You can only father well when you know you're a son. Do you?
05-31.act: Spend time today just being God's son. Pray like a kid talking to his dad.

06-01.prayer: Lord, I work for You today. Not for the paycheck, not for the praise.
06-01.text: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men, knowing that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
06-01.reflect: Would your work look different if Jesus signed your paycheck? He does.
06-01.act: Do your least favorite task today like Jesus is the one inspecting it.

06-02.prayer: God, thank You for giving me work to do.
06-02.text: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
06-02.reflect: Work came before the fall. It's not a curse. It's a calling. Do you see it that way?
06-02.act: Thank God for your job today, even the parts you don't like.

06-03.prayer: Lord, help me provide for my family.
06-03.text: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
06-03.reflect: Provision is more than money. It's presence, protection, and spiritual leadership too. Where are you short?
06-03.act: Provide one thing for your family today that money can't buy.

06-04.prayer: God, make me excellent at what I do.
06-04.text: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will stand in the presence of kings. He will not stand before obscure men.
06-04.reflect: Are you getting better at your craft or just getting by?
06-04.act: Spend 20 minutes today learning something that makes you better at your job.

06-05.text: Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
06-05.reflect: Where have you gotten lazy at work? Be honest.
06-05.act: Finish the task you've been putting off. Today.

06-06.prayer: God, I give You my plans.
06-06.text: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
06-06.reflect: Do you pray over your work or just your problems?
06-06.act: Pray over your to-do list before you start today.

06-07.prayer: Lord, rescue me from working myself into the ground.
06-07.text: For what does a man get for all the toil and striving with which he labors under the sun? Indeed, all his days are filled with grief, and his task is sorrowful; even at night his mind does not rest. This too is futile.
06-07.reflect: Can't sleep because of work? Overwork wrecks your heart, your sleep, and your family. What's it costing you?
06-07.act: Set a hard stop on work tonight. Then move your body and get to bed.

06-08.prayer: God, give me a strong work ethic.
06-08.text: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: "If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat."
06-08.reflect: Paul didn't tolerate laziness. Neither should you, starting with yourself.

06-09.prayer: Lord, keep me focused on real work, not fantasies.
06-09.text: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies lacks judgment.
06-09.reflect: Are you chasing get-rich-quick dreams or working the land God gave you?
06-09.act: Focus on one productive thing today instead of scrolling or daydreaming.

06-10.prayer: God, every ability I have comes from You.
06-10.text: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers, as it is this day.
06-10.reflect: Success can make a man forget God. Has it done that to you?
06-10.act: Thank God out loud for one success you've been taking credit for.

06-11.prayer: Lord, help me seek You first.
06-11.text: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
06-11.reflect: What do you seek first in the morning? Your phone? Your inbox? Or God?
06-11.act: Give God the first ten minutes of tomorrow before anything else.

06-12.prayer: God, take my worry about tomorrow.
06-12.text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
06-12.reflect: Money worries can eat a man alive. What are you anxious about financially?
06-12.act: Handle today's work well. Leave tomorrow to God.

06-13.prayer: Lord, keep me honest in business.
06-13.text: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD, but an accurate weight is His delight.
06-13.reflect: Fudged numbers, padded hours, half-truths to customers. God sees all of it.
06-13.act: Correct one thing at work that isn't fully honest.

06-14.prayer: Jesus, teach me to start my day like You did.
06-14.text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house, and went out to a solitary place to pray.
06-14.reflect: Jesus won the morning before the crowds came. How do your mornings start?
06-14.act: Build a morning routine: prayer, Scripture, movement. Then work.

06-15.prayer: God, give me good will toward the people I work for.
06-15.text: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
06-15.reflect: Do you serve your boss, clients, or customers with good will or a bad attitude?
06-15.act: Serve someone at work today with a genuinely good attitude.

06-16.prayer: Lord, make me faithful in the small stuff.
06-16.text: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with very much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with very much.
06-16.reflect: Small compromises lead to big ones. Where are you cutting small corners?
06-16.act: Do one small job perfectly today, even if no one notices.

06-17.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to the riches of His glory in Christ Jesus.
06-17.reflect: Your job is a tool. God is the source. Do you trust the tool or the Source?
06-17.act: Pray about your finances today with trust, not panic.

06-18.prayer: Lord, I give You my first and best.
06-18.text: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your crops; then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
06-18.reflect: Does God get your first or your leftovers?
06-18.act: Look at your budget. Make sure giving comes first.

06-19.prayer: Jesus, make me a servant leader.
06-19.text: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
06-19.reflect: If you lead people, do they feel served or used?
06-19.act: Serve someone who works for or with you today in a way they don't expect.

06-20.prayer: God, help me pay attention to what You've put in my care.
06-20.text: Be sure to know the state of your flocks, and pay close attention to your herds;
06-20.reflect: Do you know the real state of your finances? Your team? Your family?
06-20.act: Check in on one thing you've been avoiding looking at.

06-21.prayer: Lord, lead me to rest. Restore my soul.
06-21.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters. He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
06-21.reflect: Sometimes God has to make you lie down. When did you last unplug and get outside?
06-21.act: Get outside today. Walk, hike, or sit by water. No screens.

06-22.prayer: God, help me do more than talk.
06-22.text: There is profit in all labor, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
06-22.reflect: What have you been talking about doing for too long?
06-22.act: Take the first real step on it today.

06-23.prayer: Lord, keep me focused on the work You gave me.
06-23.text: So I sent messengers to them, saying, "I am doing a great work and cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to come down to you?"
06-23.reflect: Distractions will always call. What's pulling you off the wall?
06-23.act: Say no to one distraction today so you can finish what matters.

06-24.text: The plans of the diligent bring plenty, as surely as haste leads to poverty.
06-24.reflect: Are you making rushed decisions at work or with money?
06-24.act: Slow down on one big decision. Pray and plan before you act.

06-25.prayer: Lord, all my plans are in Your hands.
06-25.text: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will travel to this or that city, spend a year there, do business, and make a profit." You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes. Instead, you ought to say, "If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that."
06-25.reflect: Do you plan with God or just around Him?
06-25.act: Add "if the Lord wills" to your plans today. Mean it.

06-26.prayer: God, help me build wealth the right way.
06-26.text: Dishonest wealth will dwindle, but what is gathered by labor will increase.
06-26.reflect: Slow and honest beats fast and shady. Every time.
06-26.act: Put something toward savings today, even if it's small.

06-27.prayer: Lord, help me treat the people under me with fairness.
06-27.text: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
06-27.reflect: If you're the boss, remember you have a Boss. How would He grade the way you lead?
06-27.act: Recognize someone on your team today. Be specific.

06-28.prayer: God, teach me to number my days.
06-28.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
06-28.reflect: Nobody on their deathbed wishes they'd worked more. Is your health getting your leftover time?
06-28.act: Block time on your calendar this week for exercise. Treat it like a client meeting.

06-29.text: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest, and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and need like a bandit.
06-29.reflect: Rest is good. Laziness isn't. Do you know the difference in your own life?
06-29.act: Get up on time tomorrow. No snooze.

06-30.prayer: Lord, I want to hear "well done."
06-30.text: His master replied, "Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!"
06-30.reflect: Faithful, not famous. Would God say "well done" about your work this month?
06-30.act: Review your month. Thank God for the wins. Own the misses.

07-01.prayer: Lord, make me strong and courageous today.
07-01.text: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
07-01.reflect: Courage is a command, not a personality type. Where are you disobeying out of fear?
07-01.act: Do the thing you've been afraid to do. Today.

07-02.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
07-02.reflect: Five promises in one verse. Which one do you need most today?
07-02.act: Write that promise down and carry it with you.

07-03.prayer: Lord, replace my fear with power, love, and self-discipline.
07-03.text: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline.
07-03.reflect: Fear isn't from God. So where did it come from, and why are you listening to it?
07-03.act: Name your biggest fear out loud. Then pray this verse over it.

07-04.prayer: God, You will never leave me. I'm counting on it.
07-04.text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.
07-04.reflect: Freedom costs courage. What freedom in your life is fear holding hostage?
07-04.act: Thank God for the freedom you have. Pray for those who fought for it.

07-05.prayer: Lord, You're my light. Who do I need to fear?
07-05.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?
07-05.reflect: Make a list of who or what you fear. Hold it up next to God. Still scared?
07-05.act: Face one person you've been avoiding.

07-06.prayer: God, I come in Your name, not my own strength.
07-06.text: But David said to the Philistine, "You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied."
07-06.reflect: What giant is standing in front of you? Whose name are you facing it in?
07-06.act: Take one step toward your giant today.

07-07.prayer: Lord, prepare me in the hidden places.
07-07.text: David replied, "Your servant has been tending his father's sheep, and whenever a lion or a bear came and carried off a lamb from the flock, I went after it, struck it down, and delivered the lamb from its mouth. If it reared up against me, I would grab it by its fur, strike it down, and kill it."
07-07.reflect: David was ready for Goliath because he trained when nobody was watching. Your early-morning workouts count. So does your quiet time.
07-07.act: Train today like you're preparing for a battle you can't see yet.

07-08.prayer: God, help me speak up when it matters.
07-08.text: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father's house will perish. And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
07-08.reflect: Where are you staying silent when you should speak?
07-08.act: Say the thing that needs to be said. With love, but say it.

07-09.prayer: Lord, I'll obey You even if You don't rescue me.
07-09.text: If the God whom we serve exists, then He is able to deliver us from the furnace of blazing fire, and He will deliver us from your hand, O king. But even if He does not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up.
07-09.reflect: "Even if He does not." Is your obedience conditional?
07-09.act: Obey God in one area today regardless of the outcome.

07-10.prayer: God, make me bold as a lion.
07-10.text: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
07-10.reflect: Guilt makes men run. Righteousness makes men bold. Which describes you lately?
07-10.act: Clear your conscience on one thing so you can stand tall.

07-11.prayer: Jesus, let people see that I've been with You.
07-11.text: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they marveled. And they took note that these men had been with Jesus.
07-11.reflect: Their boldness came from time with Jesus, not education. How much time are you spending with Him?
07-11.act: Spend extra time with Jesus today before you face the world.

07-12.prayer: Lord, when I'm afraid, I trust You.
07-12.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
07-12.reflect: David didn't say "if." He said "when." Fear will come. What will you do with it?
07-12.act: Memorize this verse. Use it the next time fear hits.

07-13.prayer: Jesus, call me out of the boat.
07-13.text: "Come," said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and went toward Jesus. But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, "Lord, save me!" Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter.
07-13.reflect: Peter sank, but he's the only one who walked on water. What boat are you hiding in?
07-13.act: Take one faith risk today. Keep your eyes on Jesus.

07-14.prayer: Lord, keep me strong for the long haul.
07-14.text: Still I am as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. As my strength was then, so it is now for war and for going out and coming in.
07-14.reflect: Caleb said this at 85. He was still ready to take a mountain. What will your body be ready for at 85?
07-14.act: Start a new physical challenge this month that scares you a little.

07-15.prayer: God, You're my refuge when everything shakes.
07-15.text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble. Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
07-15.reflect: What's shaking in your life right now? Is God your refuge or your last resort?
07-15.act: Run to God first today when trouble hits.

07-16.prayer: Jesus, You've overcome. I'll take courage.
07-16.text: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!
07-16.reflect: Jesus promised trouble. He also promised victory. Which one are you focused on?
07-16.act: Encourage a man who's going through trouble right now.

07-17.prayer: Lord, help me finish my race.
07-17.text: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus—the ministry of testifying to the good news of God's grace.
07-17.reflect: Paul cared more about finishing than surviving. What's your course?
07-17.act: Do one thing today that moves your God-given mission forward.

07-18.prayer: God, see me the way You saw Gideon.
07-18.text: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, "The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor."
07-18.reflect: Gideon was hiding when God called him mighty. God sees who you'll become, not just who you are.
07-18.act: Step into one thing God's calling you to, even if you feel unqualified.

07-19.prayer: Lord, help me fear You more than people.
07-19.text: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
07-19.reflect: Whose opinion controls you? Your boss? Your buddies? Your wife? God's should matter most.
07-19.act: Make one decision today based only on what God thinks.

07-20.prayer: God, give me courage to do the work.
07-20.text: David also said to his son Solomon, "Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will not leave you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished."
07-20.reflect: "Do the work." Courage isn't a feeling. It's showing up and doing the work.
07-20.act: Show up and do the work today, scared or not.

07-21.prayer: Lord, steady my heart for whatever news comes.
07-21.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
07-21.reflect: Lots of men avoid the doctor because they're scared of what they'll hear. That's not courage. That's avoidance.
07-21.act: Schedule the screening or checkup you've been dodging.

07-22.prayer: God, I'm strong in You, not in me.
07-22.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
07-22.reflect: Your strength runs out. His doesn't. Where are you running on your own power?
07-22.act: Ask God for strength before every hard moment today.

07-23.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
07-23.reflect: Worst case, what can people actually do to you? Now compare that to Who's on your side.
07-23.act: Stand firm on one conviction today, even if it's unpopular.

07-24.prayer: God, let Christ be honored in my body.
07-24.text: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness, so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
07-24.reflect: Paul wanted Christ honored in his body. How does what you do with your body honor Him?
07-24.act: Use your body today for something that honors God: serve, work, train, help.

07-25.text: Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle is not yours, but God's.
07-25.reflect: What battle are you fighting alone that belongs to God?
07-25.act: Hand that battle to God in prayer. Then do your part and trust Him.

07-26.text: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, "Let us go up at once and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!"
07-26.reflect: Ten men saw giants. Caleb saw God's promise. What do you see?
07-26.act: Speak faith instead of fear in a conversation today.

07-27.prayer: Lord, give me courage to share my faith.
07-27.text: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
07-27.reflect: Could you explain your faith in two minutes? Have you ever tried?
07-27.act: Write out your two-minute story of how God changed you.

07-28.prayer: God, help me strengthen weak men around me.
07-28.text: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees! Say to those with anxious hearts: "Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come."
07-28.reflect: Some of your brothers are struggling with their health and too proud to say it. Who comes to mind?
07-28.act: Invite a buddy to work out or walk with you this week.

07-29.prayer: Father, You're for me. That's enough.
07-29.text: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
07-29.reflect: If God is for you, what's stopping you?
07-29.act: Make the call, send the email, or have the talk you've been dreading.

07-30.prayer: Lord, strengthen my heart as I hope in You.
07-30.text: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
07-30.reflect: Courage grows from hope. What are you hoping in?
07-30.act: Write down three things you're trusting God for.

07-31.prayer: Jesus, make me faithful to the end.
07-31.text: Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
07-31.reflect: Courage isn't one big moment. It's faithfulness every day until the end.
07-31.act: Recommit to finishing strong. Tell a brother so he can hold you to it.

08-01.prayer: Lord, give me men who sharpen me, and make me one who sharpens them.
08-01.text: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.
08-01.reflect: Sharpening creates sparks and friction. Do you have friends who'll push back on you?
08-01.act: Ask a friend this week: "Where do you see me drifting?"

08-02.prayer: God, give me a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
08-02.text: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
08-02.reflect: Lots of buddies isn't the same as one real friend. Who's your one?
08-02.act: Call that one friend today. Not text. Call.

08-03.prayer: Lord, help me carry my brother's load.
08-03.text: Carry one another's burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
08-03.reflect: Who's carrying something heavy that you know about? What are you doing about it?
08-03.act: Help carry one man's burden this week. Show up, call, or bring a meal.

08-04.prayer: God, keep me showing up for my brothers.
08-04.text: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds. Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
08-04.reflect: Skipping men's group becomes a habit fast. Are you showing up?
08-04.act: Commit to your group or find one. No excuses this month.

08-05.prayer: Lord, give me the guts to be honest with another man.
08-05.text: Therefore confess your sins to one another and pray for one another so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
08-05.reflect: Healing comes through confession to each other, not just to God. Who knows your real struggles?
08-05.act: Confess one struggle to a trusted brother this week.

08-06.prayer: God, give me a Jonathan, and make me one.
08-06.text: After David had finished speaking with Saul, the souls of Jonathan and David were knit together, and Jonathan loved David as himself.
08-06.reflect: Jonathan gave up his own shot at the throne for his friend. Are you that kind of friend?
08-06.act: Do something today that helps a friend win, even if it costs you.

08-07.prayer: Lord, give me men who'll hold my arms up.
08-07.text: When Moses' hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.
08-07.reflect: Even Moses got tired. You'll quit your health goals alone. Who's holding your arms up?
08-07.act: Find a training partner or accountability buddy for your health this month.

08-08.prayer: God, give me friends who tell me the truth.
08-08.text: The wounds of a friend are faithful, but the kisses of an enemy are deceptive.
08-08.reflect: Do your friends only tell you what you want to hear? Do you?
08-08.act: Thank the friend who last told you something hard. Then tell a friend a hard truth with love.

08-09.prayer: Jesus, teach me to lay down my life for my friends.
08-09.text: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
08-09.reflect: Most of us won't die for a friend. But will you give up a Saturday?
08-09.act: Give up something you want this week to show up for a friend.

08-10.prayer: Lord, make me a friend for the hard times.
08-10.text: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
08-10.reflect: Easy to be a friend when things are good. Who's in a hard season right now?
08-10.act: Reach out to a man going through a divorce, job loss, or grief.

08-11.prayer: God, use my words to build men up.
08-11.text: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, as you are already doing.
08-11.reflect: Men rarely hear encouragement from other men. You can change that.
08-11.act: Text three men today with specific encouragement.

08-12.prayer: Lord, help me restore a fallen brother.
