08-12.text: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
08-12.reflect: Restore, not shame. Gentleness, not gossip. How do you treat a brother who falls?
08-12.act: Reach out to a man who's fallen. Offer help, not judgment.

08-13.prayer: God, help me choose my friends wisely.
08-13.text: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
08-13.reflect: Look at the five men you spend the most time with. Are they making you wiser?
08-13.act: Spend more time this week with a man who makes you better.

08-14.prayer: Lord, surround me with men who build good habits.
08-14.text: Do not be deceived: "Bad company corrupts good character."
08-14.reflect: Your crew shapes how you eat, drink, and train. Are your friends pulling you toward health or away from it?
08-14.act: Plan one get-together this week built around something healthy: a hike, a game, a workout.

08-15.prayer: God, devote me to real fellowship.
08-15.text: They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
08-15.reflect: Teaching, fellowship, meals, prayer. Which is missing from your friendships?
08-15.act: Share a meal with a brother this week and pray together before you leave.

08-16.prayer: Lord, bring unity among the men around me.
08-16.text: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
08-16.reflect: Is there a brother you're at odds with? What would it take to make peace?
08-16.act: Take the first step toward peace with a brother today.

08-17.prayer: God, make me the kind of friend who'd tear off a roof.
08-17.text: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men. Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven."
08-17.reflect: Jesus saw their faith. Four men carried their friend to Him. Who are you carrying to Jesus?
08-17.act: Invite a friend who doesn't know Jesus to church or your men's group.

08-18.prayer: Lord, help me feel what my brothers feel.
08-18.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
08-18.reflect: Can you celebrate a friend's win without envy? Can you sit in his loss without fixing it?
08-18.act: Celebrate a friend's win today. Out loud.

08-19.prayer: God, give me courage to handle conflict the right way.
08-19.text: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
08-19.reflect: Do you talk to him or about him?
08-19.act: If you have an issue with a brother, go to him directly. Privately.

08-20.prayer: Lord, get my eyes off myself.
08-20.text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
08-20.reflect: When did you last ask a friend what he needs and then actually follow up?
08-20.act: Ask a brother how you can pray for him. Then pray all week.

08-21.prayer: God, heal the isolation I've gotten used to.
08-21.text: Oil and incense bring joy to the heart, and the sweetness of a friend is counsel to the soul.
08-21.reflect: Isolation is hard on a man's mind and body. Many men have no close friends. Is that you?
08-21.act: Make plans with a friend this week. Put it on the calendar.

08-22.text: "Do not be afraid," David said to him, "for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table."
08-22.reflect: David kept his promise to Jonathan after Jonathan was gone. How loyal are you?
08-22.act: Keep a promise you made to a friend that you've let slide.

08-23.prayer: God, help me love with action, not just words.
08-23.text: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
08-23.reflect: "Let me know if you need anything" isn't help. Doing something is.
08-23.act: Don't offer help today. Just do something useful for a brother.

08-24.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom in my friendships.
08-24.text: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the ways of the wicked lead them astray.
08-24.reflect: Is there a friendship pulling you away from God?
08-24.act: Set a boundary with one friendship that's dragging you down.

08-25.prayer: God, give me brothers who pursue You with me.
08-25.text: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
08-25.reflect: Flee and pursue, together. You can't do this alone. Who's running with you?
08-25.act: Ask a brother to pursue one spiritual goal with you this month.

08-26.prayer: Lord, give me a mentor. Make me one.
08-26.text: But Elisha replied, "As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you."
08-26.reflect: Elisha stuck with Elijah and learned everything. Who are you learning from? Who's learning from you?
08-26.act: Ask an older man you respect to meet with you. Or offer to meet with a younger one.

08-27.text: But Barnabas took Saul and brought him to the apostles. He described how Saul had seen the Lord on the road and how the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus Saul had spoken boldly in the name of Jesus.
08-27.reflect: Everyone feared Saul. Barnabas vouched for him. Who needs someone to vouch for him?
08-27.act: Speak up for a man who's been overlooked or doubted.

08-28.prayer: Lord, help us keep each other on track every day.
08-28.text: But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called Today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin's deceitfulness.
08-28.reflect: Daily check-ins keep men from drifting, in faith and in health. Who checks in on you?
08-28.act: Start a daily check-in text with a brother: one workout, one prayer, one win.

08-29.prayer: God, let Your Word fill our friendships.
08-29.text: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
08-29.reflect: Do your conversations with friends ever go deeper than sports and work?
08-29.act: Share a Scripture verse with a friend today and tell him why it matters to you.

08-30.text: Many a man proclaims his own loyalty, but who can find a trustworthy man?
08-30.reflect: Talk is cheap. Can your friends actually count on you?
08-30.act: Follow through on every commitment you make today.

08-31.prayer: Jesus, help me love my brothers like You love me.
08-31.text: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another. By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.
08-31.reflect: The world knows you're His by how you love other believers. What does your love say?
08-31.act: Look back at August. Which friendship grew? Keep investing there.

09-01.prayer: Lord, show me the way out when temptation comes.
09-01.text: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.
09-01.reflect: There's always an exit. Are you looking for it or ignoring it?
09-01.act: Plan your exit for your most common temptation. Write it down.

09-02.prayer: God, help me kill sin while it's small.
09-02.text: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed. Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
09-02.reflect: Desire, then sin, then death. Where in that chain do you usually try to stop?
09-02.act: Stop it at the desire stage today. The first thought, not the third.

09-03.prayer: Lord, give me the sense to run.
09-03.text: She grabbed Joseph by his cloak and said, "Sleep with me!" But leaving his cloak in her hand, he escaped and ran outside.
09-03.reflect: Joseph didn't debate. He ran. What are you trying to resist that you should be running from?
09-03.act: Run from one tempting situation today. Physically leave.

09-04.prayer: God, I make a covenant with my eyes today.
09-04.text: I have made a covenant with my eyes. How then could I gaze at a young woman?
09-04.reflect: Job decided ahead of time where his eyes would go. Have you?
09-04.act: Make your own covenant. Say it out loud to God.

09-05.text: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
09-05.reflect: Jesus raised the bar to the heart. Where is your thought life taking you?
09-05.act: Install a filter or accountability software on your devices today.

09-06.prayer: God, keep me where I'm supposed to be.
09-06.text: One evening David got up from his bed and strolled around on the roof of the palace. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing—a very beautiful woman.
09-06.reflect: David was supposed to be at war. Idle and restless, he fell. When are you most idle?
09-06.act: Fill your idle hours this week with something purposeful.

09-07.prayer: Lord, keep me clear-headed and alert.
09-07.text: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.
09-07.reflect: Tired, buzzed, or wired men make bad decisions. Is anything dulling your mind?
09-07.act: Go to bed early tonight and skip the alcohol. Stay sharp.

09-08.prayer: God, keep me pure through Your Word.
09-08.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
09-08.reflect: Purity isn't willpower. It's guarded by the Word. How much Word is in you?
09-08.act: Read a full chapter of Scripture today.

09-09.prayer: Lord, plant Your Word deep in me.
09-09.text: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
09-09.reflect: You can't use what you don't remember. How many verses do you know by heart?
09-09.act: Memorize one verse this week to fight your biggest temptation.

09-10.prayer: Jesus, teach me to fight back with Scripture.
09-10.text: But Jesus answered, "It is written: Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God."
09-10.reflect: Jesus was starving and still said no. He fought with Scripture. What do you fight with?
09-10.act: When temptation hits today, answer it with a verse out loud.

09-11.text: For we do not have a High Priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
09-11.reflect: Jesus gets it. He's not shocked by your temptation. Bring it to Him.
09-11.act: Tell Jesus exactly what you're tempted by. No hiding.

09-12.prayer: God, let me walk securely in integrity.
09-12.text: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
09-12.reflect: Men with secrets never rest easy. Is there anything you'd hate to have found out?
09-12.act: Bring one secret into the light with a trusted brother.

09-13.prayer: Lord, nothing is hidden from You.
09-13.text: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.
09-13.reflect: Hidden sin always surfaces. Better to confess it than be caught.
09-13.act: Deal with it before it deals with you.

09-14.prayer: God, help me cut off the supply line.
09-14.text: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh to gratify its desires.
09-14.reflect: "Make no provision" means don't stock it. Junk in the pantry, beer in the fridge, apps on the phone. What are you keeping within reach?
09-14.act: Remove one thing from your house or phone that makes it easy to fail.

09-15.prayer: Lord, guard what I put in front of my eyes.
09-15.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
09-15.reflect: What shows, sites, or feeds are worthless? Why are they still in front of you?
09-15.act: Unfollow, unsubscribe, or delete one worthless thing today.

09-16.prayer: God, let my integrity guide me.
09-16.text: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.
09-16.reflect: Integrity means whole. Same man at church, at work, at home, and alone. Are you?
09-16.act: Pick the area where you're least consistent and fix one thing.

09-17.prayer: Lord, I want to dwell close to You.
09-17.text: O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain? He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
09-17.reflect: Truth from the heart, not just the mouth. Do you believe what you say?
09-17.act: Be fully honest in every conversation today. No spin.

09-18.prayer: God, strip the lies from my life.
09-18.text: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
09-18.reflect: Little lies, exaggerations, excuses. They add up. Which ones do you tell most?
09-18.act: Catch yourself in one small lie today and correct it on the spot.

09-19.text: Simply let your "Yes" be "Yes," and your "No," "No." Anything more comes from the evil one.
09-19.reflect: If you need to swear on something for people to believe you, your word isn't good enough.
09-19.act: Only commit to what you'll actually do today.

09-20.prayer: God, I submit to You. Now I'll resist.
09-20.text: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
09-20.reflect: Order matters. Submit first, then resist. Are you trying to resist without submitting?
09-20.act: Submit one area to God in prayer. Then resist temptation there all day.

09-21.text: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
09-21.reflect: What do you use to take the edge off? Is it controlling you more than you control it?
09-21.act: Take a break from alcohol this week. See what you learn about yourself.

09-22.prayer: Lord, keep my feet off the wrong path.
09-22.text: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers. Avoid it; do not travel on it; turn from it and pass on.
09-22.reflect: Avoid, don't travel, turn, pass on. Four warnings. Where do you keep walking past the warning signs?
09-22.act: Change one route, routine, or habit that leads you toward sin.

09-23.prayer: God, help me control my body in holiness.
09-23.text: For it is God's will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality; each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
09-23.reflect: Wondering about God's will? This is part of it. Clear as day.
09-23.act: Tell an accountability partner where you stand in this area. Honestly.

09-24.prayer: Lord, test me. Show me what's really in my heart.
09-24.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
09-24.reflect: Do you want God to examine you, or are you afraid of what He'll find?
09-24.act: Ask God to show you one blind spot today. Pay attention.

09-25.prayer: God, keep me from playing with fire.
09-25.text: Can a man embrace fire and his clothes not be burned?
09-25.reflect: What "harmless" thing are you flirting with that could burn your life down?
09-25.act: Put distance between you and that fire today.

09-26.prayer: Lord, let Your grace train me to say no.
09-26.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone. It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
09-26.reflect: Grace doesn't just forgive. It trains you to say no. Are you letting it?
09-26.act: Say no to one worldly thing today because of grace, not guilt.

09-27.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts. See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
09-27.reflect: This is a dangerous prayer. Are you willing to pray it and mean it?
09-27.act: Pray this slowly. Write down whatever God brings to mind.

09-28.prayer: Lord, don't let anything master me.
09-28.text: "Everything is permissible for me," but not everything is beneficial. "Everything is permissible for me," but I will not be mastered by anything.
09-28.reflect: Energy drinks, sugar, screens, nicotine. Not sinful by themselves, but could you go without? If not, who's in charge?
09-28.act: Pick one thing you lean on daily and go without it for three days.

09-29.prayer: God, make me blameless in my work.
09-29.text: Then the administrators and satraps began searching for a charge against Daniel concerning the kingdom, but they could find no charge or corruption, because he was trustworthy, and no negligence or corruption was found in him.
09-29.reflect: Daniel's enemies dug and found nothing. What would they find on you?
09-29.act: Clean up one thing at work that wouldn't hold up to inspection.

09-30.prayer: Lord, You're able to keep me from falling. I trust You.
09-30.text: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
09-30.reflect: You're not strong enough to keep yourself. He is.
09-30.act: Thank God for every temptation you beat this month. Lean on Him for the next one.

10-01.prayer: Lord, teach me to talk to You all day long.
10-01.reflect: Prayer isn't a meeting you schedule. It's a line you keep open. Is yours open?
10-01.act: Pray short prayers all day: in the truck, between calls, during your workout.

10-02.prayer: Father, I'm shutting the door. It's just You and me.
10-02.text: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
10-02.reflect: Do you have a place where you meet God alone?
10-02.act: Pick your spot. Meet God there tomorrow morning.

10-03.prayer: Our Father, Your name is holy. Your will first.
10-03.text: So then, this is how you should pray: "Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven."
10-03.reflect: Jesus starts with God's name and God's will, not your wish list. How do your prayers start?
10-03.act: Start every prayer today with praise before asking for anything.

10-04.prayer: Father, give me what I need today. Forgive me as I forgive.
10-04.text: Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
10-04.reflect: Daily bread means daily dependence. And forgiveness flows both ways. Who haven't you forgiven?
10-04.act: Ask God for today's needs only. Then forgive one person.

10-05.prayer: Lord, lead me away from temptation today.
10-05.text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.
10-05.reflect: Do you pray for protection before temptation shows up or only after you fall?
10-05.act: Pray this verse every morning this week before you check your phone.

10-06.prayer: God, I'm asking. I'm seeking. I'm knocking.
10-06.text: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
10-06.reflect: What have you stopped asking God for because you gave up?
10-06.act: Start asking again. Write it down and pray it daily.

10-07.prayer: Lord, I hand You my anxiety. Guard my heart and mind.
10-07.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
10-07.reflect: Anxiety shows up in your body: tight chest, clenched jaw, bad sleep. Prayer is God's answer for it.
10-07.act: When anxiety hits, stop, breathe slowly, and pray this verse. Then go for a walk.

10-08.prayer: God, I'm calling. Show me what I don't know.
10-08.text: Call to Me and I will answer you, and I will tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
10-08.reflect: Do you pray expecting God to answer? Or just out of habit?
10-08.act: Pray today, then sit in silence for five minutes and listen.

10-09.prayer: Lord, I need wisdom. I'm asking.
10-09.text: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
10-09.reflect: What decision are you facing that you haven't prayed about?
10-09.act: Pray about that decision before you make it. Ask a godly man for input too.

10-10.prayer: God, keep me praying when I want to quit.
10-10.text: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart.
10-10.reflect: Have you lost heart in prayer? What made you quit?
10-10.act: Pick back up one prayer you gave up on.

10-11.prayer: Lord, You hear me in the morning. I'm here.
10-11.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
10-11.reflect: David prayed and then waited with expectation. Do you wait, or just move on?
10-11.act: Pray first thing tomorrow before your feet hit the floor.

10-12.prayer: Holy Spirit, pray for me when I don't have the words.
10-12.text: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
10-12.reflect: You don't need perfect words. Sometimes "help" is enough.
10-12.act: Bring God the thing you don't know how to pray about. Just sit with Him.

10-13.prayer: God, line up my prayers with Your will.
10-13.text: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
10-13.reflect: Are your prayers mostly about your will or His?
10-13.act: Pray for one thing today you know is God's will: your family's faith, your purity, your growth.

10-14.prayer: Lord, quiet me down. I need to be still.
10-14.text: Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.
10-14.reflect: Men are always moving. Your body and mind need stillness to recover. When were you last truly still?
10-14.act: Sit still for ten minutes today. Slow breaths. No phone. Just God.

10-15.prayer: God, break my heart for what breaks Yours.
10-15.text: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept. I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
10-15.reflect: Nehemiah prayed before he built. What's broken around you that you've never prayed about?
10-15.act: Pray about one broken thing in your community today.

10-16.prayer: Lord, make prayer my habit, not my emergency plan.
10-16.text: Now when Daniel learned that the document had been signed, he went into his house, where the windows of its upper room opened toward Jerusalem. Three times a day he got down on his knees and prayed and gave thanks to his God, just as he had done before.
10-16.reflect: "Just as he had done before." Daniel's prayer life was set before the crisis hit. Is yours?
10-16.act: Set three prayer times today: morning, noon, and night.

10-17.prayer: Jesus, teach me to pull away and pray like You did.
10-17.text: Yet He frequently withdrew to the wilderness to pray.
10-17.reflect: Jesus was busy and still pulled away often. What's your excuse?
10-17.act: Get alone with God for 20 minutes this week, outside if you can.

10-18.prayer: God, I pray for our leaders.
10-18.text: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone— for kings and all those in authority, so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
10-18.reflect: Do you complain about leaders more than you pray for them?
10-18.act: Pray for your boss, your pastor, and your local leaders by name today.

10-19.prayer: Lord, meet us when we pray together.
10-19.text: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.
10-19.reflect: When did you last pray out loud with another man?
10-19.act: Pray with a brother this week. In person or on the phone.

10-20.prayer: God, I humble myself. Heal what's broken.
10-20.text: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
10-20.reflect: Humble, pray, seek, turn. Which one are you skipping?
10-20.act: Do all four today. Start with humility.

10-21.prayer: Lord, You are my healer. I bring You my body.
10-21.text: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord. And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
10-21.reflect: Pray and see the doctor. It's not either-or. Is there a health issue you've been too proud to pray about with others?
10-21.act: Ask your pastor or men's group to pray over a health need. Yours or someone else's.

10-22.prayer: God, I'm pouring it all out.
10-22.text: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
10-22.reflect: Men bottle things up. God says pour it out. What have you been holding in?
10-22.act: Write a raw, honest prayer today. Hold nothing back.

10-23.prayer: Lord, help me pray with Elijah's persistence.
10-23.text: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three years and six months. Then he prayed again, and the heavens released rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
10-23.reflect: Elijah was a man just like you. His prayers moved heaven. Why not yours?
10-23.act: Pray earnestly for one big thing today. Then keep praying.

10-24.prayer: I believe, Lord. Help my unbelief.
10-24.text: Immediately the boy's father cried out, "I do believe; help my unbelief!"
10-24.reflect: A desperate dad prayed an honest prayer, and Jesus answered. Is your faith mixed with doubt? Say so.
10-24.act: Pray this verse over the thing you struggle to trust God with.

10-25.prayer: Jesus, thank You for praying for me.
10-25.text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message, that all of them may be one,
10-25.reflect: Before the cross, Jesus prayed for you by name. Does that change how you see prayer?
10-25.act: Pray for someone today who doesn't know you're praying for them.

10-26.prayer: God, hear me in my distress.
10-26.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
10-26.reflect: Your cry reaches His ears. Every time. What's your distress right now?
10-26.act: Cry out to God about it. Out loud if you can.

10-27.prayer: Lord, make me watchful and thankful.
10-27.text: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful.
10-27.reflect: Devoted means committed, not casual. Is prayer a devotion or an afterthought?
10-27.act: Spend half your prayer time today just thanking God.

10-28.prayer: Lord, meet me on the trail.
10-28.text: Early in the evening, Isaac went out to the field to meditate, and looking up, he saw the camels approaching.
10-28.reflect: Isaac walked and prayed. Moving your body and praying go together better than you think.
10-28.act: Take a prayer walk today. Pray for every house or person you pass.

10-29.prayer: Holy Spirit, keep me alert in prayer.
10-29.text: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
10-29.reflect: This verse comes right after the armor of God. Prayer is how you fight.
10-29.act: Make a prayer list of five men. Pray for them every day this week.

10-30.text: One day in a certain place Jesus was praying. When He had finished, one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."
10-30.reflect: The disciples watched Jesus pray and wanted what He had. Who's watching you pray?
10-30.act: Let your kids or a younger man hear you pray today.

10-31.prayer: God, let my prayers rise to You.
10-31.text: May my prayer be set before You like incense, my uplifted hands like the evening offering.
10-31.reflect: Your prayers are an offering to God. How has your prayer life changed this month?
10-31.act: Set one prayer habit from this month that you'll keep for good.

11-01.prayer: Lord, train my heart to give thanks in everything.
11-01.text: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
11-01.reflect: In every circumstance, not for every circumstance. What hard thing can you still give thanks in?
11-01.act: Write down five things you're thankful for. Do it every day this month.

11-02.text: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances. I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.
11-02.reflect: Paul learned contentment. It didn't come naturally. Are you learning it or fighting it?
11-02.act: Go one day without wishing for something you don't have.

11-03.prayer: Christ, You are my strength in every season.
11-03.text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
11-03.reflect: This verse is about contentment, not touchdowns. Christ gives strength to be content in plenty and in need.
11-03.act: Thank God for His strength in your current season, whatever it is.

11-04.prayer: Lord, godliness with contentment. That's my goal.
11-04.text: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it. But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
11-04.reflect: You came with nothing. You'll leave with nothing. What are you chasing in between?
11-04.act: Give away something you don't need this week.

11-05.prayer: God, free me from the love of money.
11-05.text: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: "Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you."
11-05.reflect: Contentment comes from God's presence, not your bank account. Which are you leaning on?
11-05.act: Skip one unnecessary purchase this week. Thank God instead.

11-06.prayer: Lord, I come in with thanks.
11-06.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
11-06.reflect: Thanksgiving is the way in. Do you start prayer with complaints or thanks?
11-06.act: Start every prayer today with thanks only. Ask for nothing until you've thanked.

11-07.prayer: Lord, I won't forget what You've done for my body and soul.
11-07.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all His kindnesses— He who forgives all your iniquity and heals all your diseases,
11-07.reflect: Can you walk, lift, breathe, and see? Most men only thank God for their health after they lose it.
11-07.act: Thank God for five things your body can do. Then use one of them today.

11-08.prayer: Jesus, make me the one who comes back to say thanks.
11-08.text: When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice. He fell facedown at Jesus' feet in thanksgiving to Him—and he was a Samaritan.
11-08.reflect: Ten were healed. One came back. Which one are you?
11-08.act: Go back and thank God for a prayer He answered that you never thanked Him for.

11-09.prayer: God, show me that more won't satisfy me.
11-09.text: He who loves money is never satisfied by money, and he who loves wealth is never satisfied by income. This too is futile.
11-09.reflect: What number would be "enough"? Be honest. Did you hit it before and want more?
11-09.act: Thank God today for what you earn. Don't think about the next raise.

11-10.text: Then He said to them, "Watch out and guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions."
11-10.reflect: Your life isn't your stuff. What possession has too much of your heart?
11-10.act: Loosen your grip on one possession. Lend it, share it, or give it.

11-11.prayer: God, You made today. I'll rejoice in it.
11-11.text: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
11-11.reflect: Today's a gift. Veterans paid for many of our days. How will you use this one?
11-11.act: Thank a veteran today. Then make today count.

11-12.prayer: Father, every good thing came from You.
11-12.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
11-12.reflect: Your wife, your kids, your job, your health. All gifts. Do you treat them that way?
11-12.act: Tell God and one person about a gift you've been taking for granted.

11-13.prayer: Lord, kill the comparison in me.
11-13.text: You shall not covet your neighbor's house. You shall not covet your neighbor's wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.
11-13.reflect: His truck, his house, his paycheck, his life. What do you covet most?
11-13.act: Pray a blessing over the man you envy. Mean it.

11-14.prayer: God, help me stop comparing my progress to other men.
11-14.text: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
11-14.reflect: Social media is full of other men's highlight reels: bodies, lifts, race times. Comparison will steal your joy and your consistency.
11-14.act: Compare yourself only to where you were last year. Write down how you've grown.

11-15.prayer: Lord, my lines have fallen in pleasant places.
11-15.text: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
11-15.reflect: Look at the boundaries of your life. Where has God been better to you than you deserve?
11-15.act: Walk your property, your neighborhood, or your workplace and thank God for it.

11-16.prayer: God, even when it all fails, I'll rejoice in You.
11-16.text: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vine, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls, yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
11-16.reflect: Could you still praise God if the business failed? If the money dried up?
11-16.act: Praise God today for who He is, not for what He's given.

11-17.prayer: Lord, keep praise on my lips.
11-17.text: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
11-17.reflect: Do the people around you hear you complain or give thanks more?
11-17.act: No complaining today. Every time you catch one, replace it with a thank-you.

11-18.prayer: God, I'd rather have little with You than a lot without You.
11-18.text: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil.
11-18.reflect: Is your pursuit of more creating turmoil at home?
11-18.act: Choose peace over profit on one decision this week.

11-19.prayer: Lord, help me invest in what lasts.
11-19.text: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal. But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven,
11-19.reflect: Where are you storing your treasure? Your calendar and your bank statement will tell you.
11-19.act: Invest time or money in something eternal this week.

11-20.prayer: God, You're good. Your love never quits.
11-20.text: O give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
11-20.reflect: God's goodness doesn't depend on your circumstances. Do you believe that today?
11-20.act: Tell your family one way God has been good to your house this year.

11-21.prayer: Lord, thank You for the food on my table.
11-21.text: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
11-21.reflect: Thanksgiving week is coming. Food is a gift to enjoy with gratitude. Eat until satisfied, then thank the Giver.
11-21.act: At every meal this week, pause and give thanks before and after. Then go for a walk with your family.

11-22.prayer: God, let Your peace rule my heart.
11-22.text: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
11-22.reflect: Peace and thankfulness travel together. Where are you missing both?
11-22.act: Make peace with one person before Thanksgiving.

11-23.prayer: Lord, make me a cheerful giver.
11-23.text: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.
11-23.reflect: Do you give grudgingly or gladly?
11-23.act: Give generously to someone in need this week. Smile while you do it.

11-24.prayer: God, I'll tell what You've done.
11-24.text: I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will tell of all Your wonders.
11-24.reflect: Gratitude that stays inside is incomplete. Who needs to hear your story?
11-24.act: At Thanksgiving dinner, share one specific thing God did for you this year.

11-25.prayer: Father, thank You for everything. Everything.
11-25.text: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
11-25.reflect: Everything includes the hard stuff. What hard thing has God used for good?
11-25.act: Thank God for one hard thing that shaped you.

11-26.prayer: Lord, give me just what I need.
11-26.text: Remove far from me falsehood and lies; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the food I need. Otherwise, I may have too much and deny You, saying, "Who is the LORD?" Or I may become poor and steal, profaning the name of my God.
11-26.reflect: Too much can make you forget God. Too little can tempt you to cut corners. Can you trust God for "enough"?
11-26.act: Pray this prayer for your finances today.

11-27.prayer: God, I come into Your presence with thanks and a song.
11-27.text: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
11-27.reflect: When did you last worship out loud? Men need to praise too.
11-27.act: Turn up a worship song today and sing along. Nobody's judging.

11-28.prayer: Lord, You never sleep, so I can.
11-28.text: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber. Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
11-28.reflect: Holidays wreck sleep and routines. God's keeping watch. You can rest.
11-28.act: Get back on your sleep and training routine today after the holiday.

11-29.text: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
11-29.reflect: Of all your blessings, Jesus is the one you can't lose. Is He at the top of your list?
11-29.act: Put Jesus first on today's gratitude list. Then thank Him for each thing after.

11-30.text: "The LORD is my portion," says my soul, "therefore I will hope in Him."
11-30.reflect: If God is your portion, you already have enough.
11-30.act: Read through your gratitude list from this month. Let it sink in.

12-01.prayer: Jesus, Prince of Peace, rule my life this month.
12-01.text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
12-01.reflect: Four names. Which one do you need Him to be for you right now?
12-01.act: Pray to Jesus by that name all day today.

12-02.prayer: God, You bring life out of dead stumps.
12-02.text: Then a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.
12-02.reflect: Israel looked finished. God grew something new. What looks dead in your life?
12-02.act: Pray for God to bring new life to that one dead area.

12-03.prayer: Lord, You use small places and small men.
12-03.text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel—One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
12-03.reflect: Bethlehem was a nothing town. Do you think you're too small for God to use?
12-03.act: Do one small thing faithfully today. God handles the big picture.

12-04.text: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly. But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, "Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit."
12-04.reflect: Even when he thought he'd been wronged, Joseph chose to protect her. How do you treat people when you feel wronged?
12-04.act: Protect someone's reputation today instead of exposing them.

12-05.prayer: Lord, make me a man who obeys quickly.
12-05.text: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him and embraced Mary as his wife.
12-05.reflect: Joseph woke up and obeyed. No delay, no debate. What has God told you to do that you're sitting on?

12-06.prayer: Jesus, You came to save me from my sins.
12-06.text: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.
12-06.reflect: His name means "the Lord saves." What sin do you still need saving from?
12-06.act: Bring that sin to Jesus by name today.

12-07.prayer: Lord, keep me on purpose through the holidays.
12-07.text: Therefore I do not run aimlessly; I do not fight like I am beating the air.
12-07.reflect: December is when routines fall apart: parties, travel, late nights. Don't drift. Have a plan.
12-07.act: Write your holiday plan for training, sleep, and Scripture. Keep it simple and doable.

12-08.prayer: God, nothing is impossible for You.
12-08.text: For nothing will be impossible with God.
12-08.reflect: What have you decided is impossible? Have you asked God about it?
12-08.act: Pray boldly for one "impossible" thing this week.

12-09.prayer: Jesus, You came humble. Make me humble.
12-09.text: and she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
12-09.reflect: No room for Him then. Is there room for Him in your schedule this month?
12-09.act: Clear room in your calendar this week for time with Jesus.

12-10.prayer: Lord, thank You for good news.
12-10.text: But the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people: Today in the City of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!"
12-10.reflect: The first to hear were blue-collar shepherds. The good news is for working men.
12-10.act: Share this good news with someone at work this week.

12-11.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!
12-11.reflect: Glory to God first, then peace to men. Does your Christmas start with God's glory or your to-do list?
12-11.act: Spend five minutes just praising God before you start your day.

12-12.prayer: Lord, slow me down to think about what You've done.
12-12.text: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.
12-12.reflect: Pondering takes time. In the rush of December, are you missing what God is doing?
12-12.act: Take a quiet ten minutes today. Think back on this year with God.

12-13.prayer: God, make me a man who goes back to work praising You.
12-13.text: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, which was just as the angel had told them.
12-13.reflect: The shepherds went back to the same job, but changed. Does meeting Jesus change how you work?
12-13.act: Go to work today with a thankful attitude. Let it show.

12-14.prayer: Lord, help me be faithful in this season.
12-14.text: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven.
12-14.reflect: Some seasons are for building, some are for maintaining. Holidays are a maintenance season. Don't quit. Just hold the line.
12-14.act: Get a short workout in today, even if it's just 20 minutes. Something beats nothing.

12-15.prayer: Jesus, the Word made flesh, thank You for moving into the neighborhood.
12-15.text: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
12-15.reflect: God took on a human body. He knows hunger, exhaustion, and pain. That's how close He came.
12-15.act: Be present for someone this week the way Jesus was present for you.

12-16.prayer: Lord, You emptied Yourself. Teach me to serve.
12-16.text: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped, but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
12-16.reflect: The King became a servant. What status are you holding on to?
12-16.act: Do a humble job at home or work that you usually leave to someone else.

12-17.prayer: Jesus, I bring You my best.
12-17.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight. On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
12-17.reflect: Wise men brought their treasures. What are you bringing Jesus this Christmas?
12-17.act: Give Jesus a gift this year: time, money, or a habit you surrender.

12-18.prayer: God, make me ready to protect my family at any hour.
12-18.text: When the Magi had gone, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. "Get up!" he said. "Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him." So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt.
12-18.reflect: Joseph moved at night, on foot, with a newborn. He was ready. Are you ready to lead when your family needs it?
12-18.act: Pray over your family tonight. Ask God to make you ready.

12-19.prayer: Lord, let me see Your salvation and be at peace.
12-19.text: Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace. For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
12-19.reflect: Simeon waited his whole life and wasn't disappointed. What are you waiting on God for?
12-19.act: Thank God for His faithfulness while you wait.

12-20.prayer: Father, You sent Your Son right on time.
12-20.text: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.
12-20.reflect: God's timing is perfect, even when it feels slow. Where are you impatient with God?
12-20.act: Surrender one timeline to God today.

12-21.prayer: Jesus, give me Your peace in the holiday chaos.
12-21.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
12-21.reflect: Holiday stress is real: family tension, money, travel. Stress shows up in your sleep, your eating, and your temper.
12-21.act: Before the busiest part of your day, take a walk and pray. Reset before you react.

12-22.prayer: Lord, prepare the way in my heart.
12-22.text: A voice of one calling: "Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness; make a straight highway for our God in the desert."
12-22.reflect: What's in the way between you and God right now?

12-23.prayer: Jesus, I'm tired. I'm coming to You.
12-23.text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.
12-23.reflect: You've carried a lot this year. Jesus is offering to take the heavy end.
12-23.act: Give Jesus your heaviest burden in prayer. Then rest tonight.

12-24.prayer: Light of the world, shine in my darkness.
12-24.text: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.
12-24.reflect: Christmas isn't happy for everyone. Who around you is walking in darkness this year?
12-24.act: Reach out to someone who's lonely or grieving this Christmas.

12-25.prayer: Immanuel. God with us. God with me. Thank You.
12-25.text: Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel (which means, "God with us").
12-25.reflect: God didn't send a message. He came Himself. He's with you right now.
12-25.act: Lead your family in reading the Christmas story before opening gifts.

12-26.prayer: Lord, help me live waiting for Your return.
12-26.text: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,
12-26.reflect: He came once. He's coming again. Would He find you ready?
12-26.act: Live today like Jesus could return tonight.

12-27.prayer: King of kings, I bow to You.
12-27.text: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
12-27.reflect: The baby in the manger is the King of kings. Is He King over every part of your life?
12-27.act: Name one area you haven't surrendered to the King. Surrender it.

12-28.prayer: Lord, I'll plan. You direct my steps.
12-28.text: A man's heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
12-28.reflect: A new year is coming. What health goals do you want to set? Have you prayed about them?
12-28.act: Write one faith goal and one health goal for next year. Pray over both.

12-29.prayer: God, thank You for the day when all pain ends.
12-29.text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away. And the One seated on the throne said, "Behold, I make all things new."
12-29.reflect: No more pain. No more aging bodies. Everything new. Does that hope shape how you live now?
12-29.act: Thank God for the future He promised. Share that hope with someone hurting.

12-30.prayer: Lord, let me pass Your story to the next generation.
12-30.text: One generation will commend Your works to the next and will proclaim Your mighty acts.
12-30.reflect: What did God do this year that your kids or younger men need to hear about?

12-31.prayer: Lord, thank You for this year. Help me finish strong.
12-31.text: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
12-31.reflect: You made it 365 days. Did you fight, finish, and keep the faith this year?
12-31.act: Thank God for the year. Tomorrow, start again. Grace for yesterday.

1.name: January
1.tag: Who you are in Christ. Not who you were. Not who they said you'd be.

2.name: February
2.tag: She doesn't need a perfect man. She needs a faithful one.

3.name: March
3.tag: Your body is on loan from God. Train it, feed it, rest it like He's coming back for it.

4.name: April
4.tag: You didn't earn it. You can't repay it. You can only receive it and live like it's true.

5.name: May
5.tag: Your kids are watching. So are the young men around you. Father them on purpose.

6.name: June
6.tag: Work is worship when you do it for the right Boss. Provide well. Don't let work become your god.

7.name: July
7.tag: Courage isn't the absence of fear. It's obeying God while your knees shake.

8.name: August
8.tag: Lone wolves get picked off. Find your brothers. Be one.

9.name: September
9.tag: Integrity is who you are when the door is closed and the phone is in your hand.

10.name: October
10.tag: Men who pray are dangerous. Men who don't are on their own.

11.name: November
11.tag: A grateful man is hard to tempt and hard to discourage. Count what you have.

12.name: December
12.tag: He came as a baby. He's coming back as King. Live ready.
